title: Rewrite component docs: pattern pages, API reference, and migration playbook
creator: Priya Nair
description: Goal: unify the component documentation site so engineers and designers can quickly find pattern guidance, production-ready API examples, and migration steps for Tokens v2 and component variant consolidation. Deliverables: (1) clear pattern pages (when to use Button vs LinkButton, primary/secondary/ghost usage), (2) API reference for Buttons, Tables, and Chart components with sanitized prop examples and edge-case notes, (3) migration playbook including token mapping table and codemod links, (4) accessible examples for Tables (keyboard, focus, sorting) and Charts (aria descriptions, colorblind palettes), (5) do/don't cookbook with copy-paste snippets for teams migrating to DS-2.0.
tasks: Audit existing pages for Buttons, Tables, Charts and Tokens — compile missing patterns and outdated props
Create pattern vs reference split: pattern pages (usage + do/don't) and reference pages (API + props matrix)
Draft migration playbook: token mapping CSV + codemod usage example + rollback plan
Author accessibility checklist and add live keyboard/screen-reader examples for Tables
Add chart theming guidelines: token-based palette, recommended interaction hints, and fallback semantics
Design review of code examples and screenshots — sync with Figma frames for each pattern
Open PRs for static docs and storybook updates, run docs-ci and visual regression on examples
Collect reviewer feedback and iterate: PM, Eng, Accessibility lead sign-off
acceptance_criteria: Each component has a pattern page and an API reference page on the docs site
Migration playbook includes token mapping table and at least one working codemod with usage example
Do/don't section contains 6 concrete examples across Buttons, Tables, Charts and tokens
Accessibility checklist is present and examples pass manual smoke test with VoiceOver/NVDA
All new docs deployed to staging and linked from the Design System index page
Design and Engineering reviewers have approved changes (PRs merged)
updates: 2025-03-13: Kickoff meeting with PM (Miguel Torres), Eng lead (Ethan Caldwell) and Accessibility (Sofia Martinez). Agreed on pattern/reference split and token-first approach.
2025-03-18: Completed audit spreadsheet of 82 doc pages. Buttons and Charts are most inconsistent; Tables lack keyboard examples.
2025-03-21: Proposal accepted to ship token mapping CSV and codemod as part of docs; opted to keep examples language-agnostic but include JS/TS snippets.
2025-03-27: First draft of Button pattern page uploaded to staging. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427 — awaiting design review from Aisha Kapoor.
2025-03-30: Design review notes: simplify primary/secondary visual examples, add 'when not to use' section. See Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/DS-2.0-patterns
2025-04-01: Engineering feedback received — requested explicit prop examples for debounced sorting on Table and chart event hooks for tooltips. Added to tasks.
2025-04-02: Accessibility lead performed initial smoke tests; Tables need clearer focus ring demo and Charts require aria-describedby examples. Marked for follow-up.
Next steps: finish migration codemod, add 4 do/don't examples, iterate on accessibility changes, and merge remaining PRs before docs freeze 2025-04-15.
notes_for_engineers: Key technical decisions: (1) docs examples should import tokens from @redwood/tokens/v2 where possible; (2) prefer explicit prop-value examples (no synthetic shorthand) to avoid ambiguity; (3) include defensive rendering patterns for server-side/SSR charts to avoid window references; (4) codemod will rename token keys and adjust Chart color arrays — engineers should verify visual diffs before merge.
risk_mitigation: Ship migration playbook and codemod behind a 'migration-coderef' feature flag in docs repo
Add rollback instructions in playbook and keep old token docs available under /v1/ for 3 months
Run visual regression on all updated examples and require approval from design lead before merging
